title: Direct Materials Cost Reduction — Desktop Component Value Engineering
summary: Combined supplier strategy, cost analysis and value engineering across desktop hardware categories.
context: Desktop platforms depended on multiple suppliers across mechanical and electronic components. The sourcing program looked for savings in both supplier terms and component design.
decisions: I led cost analysis and supplier negotiations, and drove initiatives including thinner steel, cable optimization and semiconductor reclamation.
outcome: The 2016 result was US$7.83 million in savings. The example initiatives illustrate the work behind the program.
